lines.text: In the third year of the drought, the LORD told Elijah to present himself to Ahab, and He would send rain.
Obadiah, in charge of the palace, hid a hundred prophets of the LORD, fifty men per tent.
Ahab sent Obadiah to search every spring and valley for grass to keep the horses and mules alive.
Obadiah fell facedown when he met Elijah, and feared Ahab would kill him if the Spirit of the LORD carried Elijah away.
Elijah told Ahab to summon all Israel to Mount Sinai, along with the four hundred and fifty prophets of Baal.
